WITH counts_by_type AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), above_average AS (
  SELECT risk_margin_count
  FROM counts_by_type
  WHERE risk_margin_count > (SELECT AVG(risk_margin_count) FROM counts_by_type)
)
SELECT AVG(risk_margin_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(risk_margin_count - (SELECT AVG(risk_margin_count) FROM counts_by_type)) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;
